cmd.name: learn
cmd.description: Gains knowledge from a more experienced ally

cmdtext.text: Click to learn from this ally
cmdtext.default-text: Right-click to learn from this ally

cmdtext.text: Click to learn from all allies around this position

cmd.name: heal
cmd.description: Heals an ally by 20 plus the level

cmdtext.text: Click to heal all allies around this position
Click to teach all allies around this position
Click to hide all allies around this position

cmd.name: curse
cmd.description: Curses the target warrior to make him miss his next attack

cmdtext.text: Click to curse all enemies around this position

cmd.name: cripple
cmd.description: Drains all of the target's stamina

cmdtext.text: Click to cripple all enemies around this position

cmd.name: mist
cmd.description: Creates a cloud of plague that deals 45 damage to all units periodically for about 12 seconds (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: coverofmercy
cmd.description: Creates a cloud that reduces all combat damage allies receive by 50% for about 25 seconds (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: zombify
cmd.description: The unit transforms into a ghoul that remains under your control for about 10 seconds

cmd.name: ghoul_summoning
cmd.description: Summons a ghoul that remains under your control for about 10 seconds (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: wrath_of_jupiter
cmd.description: Channels the Wrath of Jupiter to strike the target with a non-lethal lightning, dealing up to 40 damage to heroes and up to 250 to all other units (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: eagle_summoning
cmd.description: Summons an eagle that remains under your control for about 2 minutes (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: crow_summoning
cmd.description: Summons a crow that remains under your control for about 4 minutes (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: wolf_summoning
cmd.description: Summons a wolf that remains under your control for about 200 seconds (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: deer_summoning
cmd.description: Summons a deer that remains under your control for about 3 minutes (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: restoration
cmd.description: Restores the stamina of up to 5 nearby allies (at the cost of life)

cmd.name: mass_heal
cmd.description: Distributes up to 1000 health among nearby allies (at the cost of life)
